name: QAPLIB
description: QAPLIB is the standard library of instances for the Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP), one of the hardest combinatorial optimization problems. It collects more than 130 instances from facility-layout, keyboard-design, hospital-layout, and other applications, grouped by originating author (e.g., nug, tai, sko, esc, lipa). Each instance lists the best-known objective value (and proven optimum where available), so exact methods and metaheuristics are scored by the gap between their assignment cost and that reference.
typical_sota_score: Many medium instances are solved to proven optimality; larger instances (e.g., tai100a) remain open, with metaheuristics matching best-known values.
reputation: The reference benchmark library for the Quadratic Assignment Problem; the standard testbed for QAP exact algorithms and metaheuristics.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; targets combinatorial optimization solvers. QAP is NP-hard and notoriously difficult, so exact optimality is known only for a subset of instances. Measures solution quality against best-known values.
